meta.plant_name: Amazon Web Services Ridgeland Data Center power station

units.notes: I checked the Mississippi air permit 1720-00099, issued June 25, 2025. Buildings 1 to 4 have 26 generators of 2,750 kilowatts each, buildings 5 to 14 have 28 each, and the small generators add 4.05 MW. That agrees with GEM, which rounds the small generators to 4.1 MW.
